name: opencode-scheduler-local
description: OpenCode v2 plugin: schedule prompts to run in new sessions, with a side panel in the desktop app.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp src/server.js src/schedule.js src/rpc.js dist/ && vite build
scripts.install-plugin: npm run build && rm -rf ~/.config/opencode/plugins/scheduler && cp -R dist ~/.config/opencode/plugins/scheduler
